parsed.post: New personal best! Increasing DEPTH to 8 and refining the hyperparameters yielded 0.9661. The larger model capacity continues to drive down val_bpb. I'll now try to squeeze out more performance by experimenting with a slightly higher learning rate and reducing weight decay to see if we can accelerate convergence without instability.
parsed.description: Increase learning rate to 0.06 and reduce weight decay to 0.03 to push convergence speed for the DEPTH 8 architecture.
